findings.evidence: `def halfTwistFrames (k : ℤ) : LocalFrames ℂ 𝕔𝔻 1 where domain := halfTwistDomain`, with no `@[expose]` and no domain lemma in the file.
findings.issue: `halfTwistFrames` is not exposed and has no lemma for its `domain` field. Downstream code (e.g. the k ≠ 0 follow-up) can't turn `a ∈ (halfTwistFrames k).domain i` into `a ∈ halfTwistDomain i`, which it needs to use `isRealAlong_core_iff`/`localTriv_baseSet_core`. `isRealAlong_halfTwistCore` only gets this through in-module defeq (`hc hi`).

findings.evidence: The proofs reach into the definitions with `simp only [halfTwistDomain, h, ↓reduceIte, ...]` and `simp only [halfTwistExponent, hi, ↓reduceIte]`, which downstream code cannot do.
findings.issue: `halfTwistDomain` and `halfTwistExponent` are unexposed `if`-definitions with no case lemmas. Nothing characterizes the domain as a membership predicate (`mem_halfTwistDomain_iff`), and nothing says the interior-centre exponent is `0` or the circle-centre exponent is `(k/2)(log i + log (z/i))`.

findings.evidence: The file has only `fiberMap_halfTwistIso_hom_of_norm_eq_one`, and `halfTwistIso` is an unexposed `def`.
findings.fix: Add `fiberMap_halfTwistIso_hom (k z) : (halfTwistIso k).hom.fiberMap z = exp (halfTwistExponent k z z) • id`, plus the `_inv` analogue and the interior case `= id` when `‖z‖ < 1`.
findings.issue: `halfTwistIso` is characterized only over the circle. There is no general `fiberMap` lemma, and nothing says it is the identity over interior points, so the iso is under-specified for computing the double.

findings.evidence: The lemmas are listed by hand in `simp only [halfTwistFrames_frame_apply, halfTwistFrames_frame_symm_apply, smul_smul]` in `isRealAlong_halfTwistCore`.
findings.issue: The normal-form lemmas `halfTwistFrames_frame_apply` and `halfTwistFrames_frame_symm_apply` lack `@[simp]`. `LocalFrames.coordChange_core_apply` (LocalFrames.lean) also lacks `@[simp]`, though it is the rewrite that turns a transition into frames.

findings.fix: State the public lemmas with `‖(i : ℂ)‖ = 1`. Keep the `¬ <` form only inside proofs.
findings.issue: The circle hypothesis takes two forms: `sq_exp_halfTwistExponent`/`exp_halfTwistExponent_self` take `¬‖i‖ < 1`, while `fiberMap_halfTwistIso_hom_of_norm_eq_one` takes `‖z‖ = 1`. `notMem_borderedInterior_iff` produces the latter, so callers must convert by hand (see `hz.symm ▸ lt_irrefl 1`).

findings.evidence: `frame` is documented as "meaningful for `x ∈ domain i`", and `continuousOn_frame` constrains it only on `domain i`.
findings.fix: Store the frame on the domain (`frame : ∀ i, domain i → …` with `ContinuousOn` replaced by `Continuous`) and extend by `id` inside `core`. Then add `@[ext]` on `domain` plus `frame` restricted to the domain.
findings.issue: The field `frame : B → B → …` is free for `x ∉ domain i`. No law or derived operation depends on those values in a meaningful way, yet they enter `core.coordChange`, so two `LocalFrames` that agree on their domains are different terms with different cores. No `@[ext]` can hold.

summary: The new LocalFrames/half-twist surface lacks characteristic lemmas that downstream code needs, because `halfTwistFrames`, `halfTwistIso` and the disc defs are unexposed with no lemmas for their domains or interior values. `LocalFrames.frame` also carries data that no law constrains, so it cannot have an `@[ext]` lemma.
